subject: Ogre pair
picture: Two huge clumsy ogres carry a stolen iron gate down a dungeon hall. Each ogre has one head, one torso, two arms, two hands, two legs, and two feet. The gate is a large simple grid as big as both of them. They strain under the weight. Stone ceiling, block walls, large floor slabs, closed wooden doors behind them. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02.
